description: Measures newly lodged or active online job advertisements scraped and deduplicated from major job boards.
underlying_construct: Employer recruitment search intensity in the digital labor market.
limitations: Biased toward digital-first and professional occupations.
Subject to deduplication errors, expired postings, and recruiter churn.
Does not measure offline vacancies, informal hiring, or net hires.

description: Measures active, unfilled positions for which recruitment action is being taken, reported by employer establishment surveys.
underlying_construct: Unfilled job openings across surveyed private and public establishments.
limitations: Establishment surveys exclude micro-enterprises (<25 employees in some jurisdictions).
Published at lower frequency (quarterly/annual) compared to web scraping.

description: Projected annual average openings resulting from macroeconomic structural growth plus occupational replacements and retirements.
underlying_construct: Long-term workforce replenishment and structural occupational expansion.
limitations: Model-based 10-year projection; not spot market vacancies.
Subject to macroeconomic forecasting error and policy shifts.

description: Total number of employed persons or workforce proportion in an occupational classification.
underlying_construct: Existing occupational stock of employed human capital.
limitations: Stock measure; does not reflect hiring velocity or vacancy turnover.

description: Estimated percentage expansion or contraction in total occupational employment over a 10-year horizon.
underlying_construct: Structural industry growth and occupational staffing pattern shifts.
limitations: Cannot capture cyclical recessions or unpredictable technological disruptions.

description: Official government assessment of labour market tightness, recruitment difficulty, and skill bottlenecks.
underlying_construct: Imbalance between employer demand and certified domestic skill supply.
limitations: Subject to political and immigration policy considerations.

description: Relative importance score (O*NET/SSG) or empirical appearance percentage of specific skills in occupational profiles.
underlying_construct: Competency prerequisites required to execute occupational tasks.
limitations: Keyword mentions do not always reflect deep operational proficiency.
